description: Edges between instruments: which national laws transpose a directive (direction 'in'), or what an instrument implements/amends (direction 'out'). Instrument-level; for article-level links use find_national_implementations.

direction.description: 'in' = edges pointing at this work (default), 'out' = from it.

eli.description: ELI URI of the instrument, e.g. 'http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/23' (UK VAT Act 1994) or 'http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2006/112/oj' (EU VAT Directive).

name: related_works

outputSchema.description: The JSON response from the corresponding Lexiara API route.
